name: list_upcoming_academic_items
description: List upcoming cached Campus events and Paideia due items in chronological order. Includes live-clock academicContext. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. If calendarRegistration.required is true on first use or after week 19, inspect the official PUCP page, call set_academic_calendar, and retry before making a week-dependent claim.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
